# release-notes

## When to use

Public functions carry doc comments describing units and failure modes. Run the unit tests before opening a pull request and paste failures verbatim. Public functions carry doc comments describing units and failure modes. Error messages are written for the on-call engineer at three in the morning.

- API handlers validate input with the schema library and return typed errors.
- When adding a dependency, explain the alternative you rejected in the PR.
